sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
Heard Sri Vishwanath Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Ajay Singh, learned AGA-I for the State and perused the records.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants, namely, Rohit,
Natthi, Boby and Rahul with the prayer to quash the impugned order of N.B.W. dated 06.03.2020 passed by Incharge Chief Judicial Magistrate, Aligarh as well as subsequent orders in Case No.
10991 of 2019 (State vs. Rohit and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 474 of 2019, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 377, 376 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Banna Devi, District Aligarh.
Rohit And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.And Another on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132300691/
1 3. Learned counsel for the applicants states that the dispute arises out of matrimonial relationship of the opposite party no. 2 with applicant no. 1.
The other applicants are the family member of the applicant no. 1.

He further submitted that an order was passed by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 21.05.2024 directing the applicants to file the said compromise deed before the court concerned which was to be verified by the court concerned.
In pursuance of the said order, the court concerned vide order dated 01.07.2024 verified the said compromise.
Copy of the same is on record.
The same is not disputed by learned counsel for the State.

4. The law with regards to quashing of a case on the basis of settlement arrived between the parties,
is well settled.

The Apex Court in the cases of (1) B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another: (2003)4 SCC 675; (2) Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation : (2008) 9 SCC 677; (3) Manoj Sharma Vs. State and others: ( 2008) 16 SCC 1; (4) Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab:
(2012) 10 SCC 303; (5) Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. And another: 2013 (83) ACC 278 and (6) Parbatbhai Ahir@Parbatbhai @ Bhimsinbhai Karmur and others Vs. State of Gujarat and another: (2017) 9 SCC 641 has held that the cases in which the parties have settled their grievances can be quashed.

sentences.text:
5. From perusal of the records and the law laid down by the Apex Court on the subject matter, the present case is a good case for exercising powers by this Court to quash the impugned N.B.W. as well as subsequent orders as prayed for by the applicant(s).
6.

7. The impugned order of N.B.W. dated 06.03.2020 as well as subsequent orders of the aforesaid case are hereby quashed subject to the applicants depositing Rs.10,000/- before the concerned trial court which shall be utilized by the District Legal Services Authority of the district.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 14.8.2024 Manoj  Rohit And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.And Another on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132300691/
